item_reviews.comment: Differences check out: 0.99-0.75, 2.86-2.35, 5.65-4.94; Method M also exceeds RanMASK everywhere.
M+ exceeds CERT-ED everywhere (0.77>0.75 marginal); below M on Yelp and Spam, far above on LUN.
All accuracy drops computed correctly against NoSmooth for M and M+.
Directions versus CERT-ED match T2 cardinality values for both M and M+.
Yelp 0.28 vs 0.26 higher; Spam 0.20 vs 0.42 and LUN 0.30 vs 0.34 lower; correct.
M+ distances 0.24 are below CERT-ED on all three datasets.
P1 states RanMASK supports only Hamming certificates; comparability caveat is supported.
Table note and statistical tests section confirm no significance tests or repeated runs.

missing_core_findings.description: Against CERT-ED, Method M and M+ did not improve clean accuracy: CERT-ED had higher accuracy on Yelp (58.57 vs 56.98/56.22) and LUN (98.20 vs 97.88/95.09), and slightly higher on SpamAssassin (88.26 vs 87.99/88.06). The certified-radius gains therefore came with small further accuracy costs.
